parts.text: A. Give the family/order/genus for metapneumovirus. (Classification, Order, Family, Subfamily, Genus, DNA, Envelope)
B. Describe the clinical presentation and name the risk groups associated with severe disease.

cohort_answer.text:
A: Classification | Metapneumovirus. Order | Mononegavirales. Family | Pneumoviridae. Subfamily | n/a. Genus | Metapneumovirus. DNA | Single-stranded, negative sense RNA. Envelope | Lipid envelope

B (Red Book 32nd edition): Clinical Presentation similar to RSV (hOPV). Incubation period 3-7 days. Spectrum: mild URI to bronchiolitis to severe pneumonia requiring mechanical ventilation. Fever, cough, coryza. In children: febrile seizures, croup, asthma exacerbations, acute otitis media. Bronchiolitis most commonly causes hospitalization at 6-12 months old. Risk factors for severe disease: Children <2 years, Comorbid conditions: Prematurity <32 weeks, underlying heart and lung disease, Immunocompromised (SCT and lung tx recipients)
